name: singlet_programs_program_usage_estimation
title: Per-cell program usage estimation
description: Estimates non-negative usage of fixed gene programs for each cell from a stored loading set, writing raw usages, row-normalised composition, per-cell coverage and residuals. The default nnls_frobenius refit matches the cNMF refit; schpf_project and expimap_encode need stored model state under models/. Use it to project discovery or query cells onto programs fitted elsewhere; do not use it to learn new programs or to assign cells to clusters or labels.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

loadings.description: Stored loading set: varm/<name> for nnls_frobenius; models/<name> for schpf_project and expimap_encode.

method.description: Usage estimator. nnls_frobenius is the cNMF-compatible default; schpf_project returns posterior means with spread.

name.description: Prefix for written members, for example obsm/program_usage and obsm/program_usage_norm.

missing_gene_policy.description: error refuses when reference genes are absent; restrict refits on shared genes only and reports coverage.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Seed for the random initialisation of the scHPF projection; other methods are deterministic.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without writing anything.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

nnls_frobenius.description: Options for the least-squares refit; ignored by other methods.

alpha_usage.description: L2 penalty on usages; 0 gives plain non-negative least squares.

tol.description: Solver tolerance for the coordinate-descent refit.

max_iter.description: Maximum solver iterations per cell batch.

schpf_project.description: Options for the Gamma-Poisson projection; ignored by other methods.

min_iter.description: Minimum variational iterations before convergence checks.

expimap_encode.description: Options for the expiMap encoder; ignored by other methods.

rectify.description: Clip negative latent means at zero to give non-negative usages.

only_active.description: Return only program terms not deactivated by the group lasso.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, for example obsm/program_usage. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs: method, n_cells, n_programs, missing_reference_genes, zero_usage_rows, median_relative_residual. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
